notes: Champion Cooler is a subsidiary of Essick Air Products, Inc. (page fact). Page header also lists Artic Circle, Essick Air, MasterCool, MoistAir, Spec-Air and UltraCool, but the page does not state those brands share these serial systems, so no sisters are claimed. Both styles are shipped YEAR-ONLY: the year digits are text-verified on the page, but each month letter mapping lives only in a chart image, so per established precedent the month is not guessed and the style is not held for completeness. Image-pass items: Style 1 month-letter chart and Style 2 month-letter chart (see report).

styles.notes: Page 1-based positions 2-3 = year digits (page marks the prefix E07), converted to 0-based half-open [1,3]. Month is the 1st character (letter) per page text, but its letter-to-month mapping is chart-only in image Champion_Essick-Air_Spec-Air-Serial-Number-Style-1_How-to-determine-the-date-of-manufacture-or-age.png, so month is null and the style ships year-only.

Page: 2nd & 4th digits combined represent the year (page marks W1B7), i.e. split positions [1,2] + [3,4] concatenating to '17' -> 2017. Month is the 3rd character (letter) per page text, but its letter-to-month mapping is chart-only in image Champion-Style-2_Date-of-Manufacture-or-age.png, so month is null and the style ships year-only. Pattern is disjoint from style-1 (letter at position 2), so no shape collision.
